text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. EllisDon Corporation is constructing a 17-storey institutional building at the lands located at 11 and 33 Centre Avenue and 80 Chestnut Street. The site is bounded by an existing commercial building (55 Centre Avenue and 108-110 Chestnut Street to the north, Chestnut Street to the east, Armoury Street to the south and Centre Avenue to the west. Operating under a monthly Street Occupation Permit, a construction staging area has been setup on the north sidewalk and a portion of the westbound curb lane on Armoury Street, between Centre Avenue and Chestnut Street. The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the closure of the north sidewalk and the two westbound lanes on Armoury Street, between Centre Avenue and Chestnut Street, from February 21, 2019 to February 21, 2020. 2. Rescinded the existing pedestrian crossover on Armoury Street, immediately east of Centre Avenue. 3. Authorized all-way compulsory stop controls at the intersection of Armoury Street and Centre Avenue. 4. Rescinded the existing parking machine regulation in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m., Monday to Saturday; and 1:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m., Sunday, on the north side of Armoury Street, between a point 23 metres west of Chestnut Street and Centre Avenue. 5. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Armoury Street, between Centre Avenue and Chestnut Street. 6.
